line: Commander, a signal is coming from the heart of the galaxy. Something vast has woken in the dark.
The Cube is leaving its orbit. Every sensor we have is locked on it.
It is descending into the gravity well, straight for the Void at the centre of the galaxy.
The Collective has taken the Void. Its tractor beams are reaching across the wreck field.
Nothing survived the last fleet that stood here. This time, it will be different.
The Battle for the Cube has begun. Take it, and hold it for your alliance.
No alliance holds the Cube yet. The first to take it starts the clock.
Our alliance holds the Cube. Every minute counts. Hold the line, Commander.
Another alliance holds the Cube. Rally the fleet, Commander. We can take it back.
These are the final hours, Commander. Whoever holds the Cube at the end takes the galaxy.
Commander, the Cube sits on the Void, and every alliance in the galaxy is closing in.
There it is, the Cube, anchored over the Void. Nothing in the galaxy is bigger.
Squadrons are making their attack runs. Watch the shields flare as they hit.
Fighters are diving on the Cube in waves. Not all of them will make a second pass.
A capital ship is passing the Cube. That is where the real damage is done.
The heavy ships are trading fire with the Cube now. Hold steady.
The wreck field grows by the minute. Every hulk out there was somebody's fleet.
So much wreckage around the Void. The salvage crews will be busy for weeks.
That is a commander's flagship, leading its fleet into the fight.
A flagship is leading the charge. Commanders are fighting on the front line today.
